name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 4 visits over 8 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 8 hours starting 2025-06-01, at wavelengths from 1.71 to 4.92 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
